# vendor/ — mirrored from starter-workspace

**DO NOT EDIT files in this folder here.**

Everything under `vendor/` is maintained in `starter-workspace` and copied into this repo by
`ik vendor sync`, run from `starter-workspace`. Local edits are overwritten on the next sync and
fail `ik vendor check` in CI.

To change a vendored package, edit it in `starter-workspace` and re-run the sync there.

See `.sync-manifest.json` for the source commit and per-file checksums.
